description: A fake GitHub MCP server for acme/lantern, release v1.5.0 after v1.4.1. PR 411 merged into `develop` on 10-05, before v1.4.1 (10-10), and reached `main` through the `Merge branch 'develop'` commit on 10-20: its merge commit is reachable from v1.5.0 and not from v1.4.1, so it belongs to v1.5.0 though its merged_at is older than the previous release. PR 399 merged on 09-28 and is in v1.4.1. GitHub's date order puts PR 411's commits after v1.4.1's sha in the walk from v1.5.0. Each call is answered by the first of a tool's `answers` whose `when` arguments all equal the call's, else `default`, and is recorded for the graders.
